spells.name: Find Steed
phrases: You summon an otherworldly being that appears as a loyal steed
This creature uses the Otherworldly Steed stat block
it shares your Initiative count, and it functions as a controlled mount
it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying
Otherworldly Steed
Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
equal to 2d8 plus the spell’s level
statBlock: Large Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (Your Choice), Neutral
HP 5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the spell’s level)
Speed 60 ft., Fly 60 ft. (requires level 4+ spell)
MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE
Languages Telepathy 1 mile (works only with you)
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Life Bond. When you regain Hit Points from a level 1+ spell, the steed regains the same number of Hit Points if you’re within 5 feet of it.
Otherworldly Slam. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 plus the spell’s level of Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.

Fell Glare (Fiend Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, one creature within 60 feet the steed can see. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.
Fey Step (Fey Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). The steed teleports, along with its rider, to an unoccupied space of your choice up to 60 feet away from itself.
Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). One creature within 5 feet of the steed regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus the spell’s level.
spells.scalingPhrase: Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block

spells.name: Aid
spells.components: V, S, M (a strip of white cloth)
phrases: Choose up to three creatures within range
Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration
spells.scalingPhrase: Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 2

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
phrases: You touch a creature and end one condition on it
Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned

spells.name: Zone of Truth
phrases: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere
a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius
Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

spells.name: Alter Self
phrases: You alter your physical form
You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers
though none of your statistics change
you use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength

spells.name: Dragon’s Breath
phrases: You touch one willing creature, and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison
exhale a 15-foot Cone
taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2

spells.name: Scorching Ray
phrases: You hurl three fiery rays
Make a ranged spell attack for each ray
the target takes 2d6 Fire damage
spells.scalingPhrase: You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2

spells.name: Suggestion
phrases: You suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range
Fetch the key to the cult’s treasure vault, and give the key to me.
have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target

spells.name: Blur
phrases: Your body becomes blurred
any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you
if it perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)
phrases: Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range
have the Paralyzed condition for the duration
the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success
spells.scalingPhrase: You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2

spells.name: Web
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)
phrases: You conjure a mass of sticky webbing at a point within range
fill a 20-foot Cube
have the Restrained condition while in the webs or until it breaks free
dealing 2d4 Fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
phrases: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier
spells.scalingPhrase: The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3

spells.name: Revivify
spells.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
phrases: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute
That creature revives with 1 Hit Point
nor does it restore any missing body parts

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
phrases: Choose any number of creatures within range
Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws
regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing

spells.name: Dispel Magic
phrases: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range
Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends
(DC 10 plus that spell’s level)
spells.scalingPhrase: You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell’s level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use

spells.name: Fear
phrases: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw
drop whatever it is holding
takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route

spells.name: Fly
phrases: You touch a willing creature
the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover
the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall
spells.scalingPhrase: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
phrases: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas
The cloud is Heavily Obscured
have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn

spells.name: Sleet Storm
phrases: sleet falls in a 40-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius Cylinder
exposed flames in the area are doused
have the Prone condition and lose Concentration

phrases: A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you
